notes: Strip d: x 5220-6860 plus overlap (x 4920-7160). Names: Rudolph printed 'RUDOLPH' (y~2100-2450) and 'AVE'; Denver printed 'AVE.' in the north and 'DENVER' (y~2700-2900); Bowman printed 'AVE.' at the top and 'BOWMAN' (y~2200); Mistletoe printed 'MISTLETOE' (west section) and 'STREET' (east section); Lockwood printed 'LOCKWOOD PL'; State printed 'AVENUE' (y~300-500) and 'STATE' (y~4500-4650); Wallace printed 'WALLACE' on both parts and 'ST.'; Detroit 'DETROIT ST.'; Kelso 'KELSO ST.'; Depot 'DEPOT' and 'ST.'; Gest 'GEST'; South 'SOUTH'; Dutten 'DUTTEN AVE.'; W. 8th 'W. EIGHTH'; Summer printed 'SUM...'/'...MMER' and 'ST.'; Boston 'BOSTON'; Factory 'FACTORY ST.'; Whateley 'WHATELEY'; Nevada 'NEVADA ST.'; Wilder 'WILDER AVE.' (on the merged street south of the Denver merge); Glenway printed 'AVENUE' here (named GLENWAY further NW); Warsaw printed 'WARSAW' (west of the strip) and 'AVE.' on the stretch at the merge. West Liberty Street is not labelled in the strip (top band, y~80-155 east of State). Unnamed (?): the NNW road off Lehman; the E-W street from the Rudolph/Denver node to Bowman; the E-W street from the Wilder corner to State; the road SW from the Glenway/Wilder X to Warsaw (Wilder's address series continues on it); the road SSE from the X to W. 8th (its addresses continue 8th's 2300 series); the street leaving Liberty's north side at x~7066. Wilder's short diagonal north of the Denver merge is named Wilder from its continuous addresses (2314-2332) and line; Denver's addresses are a separate 1700 series. Bowman narrows from ~57 px to almost nothing between Mistletoe and Lockwood and does not continue south of Lockwood. State Avenue carries tracks and pipes; its points carry ~15 px. Not streets: the PRIVATE drive and the 20 ft strip with a 10" W.P. east of State at y~2548 (State to the tracks); the narrow lanes at x~6280 (y 700-1150), x~6420-6440 (y 100-800, alley), y~2650 and y~2978 east of x 6700; the B&O R.R. and sidings; the Price Hill inclined planes and the incline track south of the X; the blue/grey/yellow/pink boundary bands (e.g. y~810, y~1150, y~1240, y~1300, y~2560, y~4810); subdivision lettering (W. ...DSONS, WEBSTER'S, STEPHEN WILDER'S SUBDIV., S. WILDER'S, G. R. WILDER'S, LEHMAN'S).
